chunqiu-temporal-retrieval

ChunQiu Temporal Retrieval

Retrieve Classical Chinese annal records for reign dates and temporal constraints while distinguishing events from later commentary.

Domain
Classical Chinese historical retrieval
Primary focus
Reign-date interpretation and event retrieval
Primary metric
Mean binary nDCG@10
temporal retrievalsearch-swe

OverviewRuntime and requirementsPublic input and output contractInputsOutputsEvaluation

Runtime and requirements

  • Agent budget: 6 hours
  • Compute: 16 CPUs, 32 GiB RAM, 100 GiB storage; one A100 40 GB GPU
  • Build limit: 1,200 seconds
  • Query limit: 120 seconds for the entire evaluation batch

Use the supplied data and local Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B model. Optional APIs must follow the documented OpenRouter/Jina allowlist. External datasets, additional model weights and answer lookup are prohibited. Batch time includes startup, input loading, inference, API calls and output writing.

Public input and output contract

Inputs

  • /task/data/corpus.jsonl — 18,662 records with doc_id and text.
  • /task/data/examples.jsonl — 6,617 labeled examples with query_id, text and relevant_doc_ids.
  • /task/data/dated_examples.jsonl — 19,452 dated associations with doc_id, time_text, reign, year and month.
  • /task/models/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B — supplied local embedding weights.

There is no separate public validation split. Training examples are not mounted in the verifier; evaluation contains 778 questions.

Outputs

Submit executable scripts and dependencies under /app:

/app/build.sh --corpus /task/data/corpus.jsonl --index-dir /app/index
/app/run.sh --index-dir /app/index --queries /path/to/queries.jsonl --output /path/to/results.jsonl --top-k 10

Build must finish initialization before queries arrive; a service may remain running. The verifier uses an unprivileged user and read-only submission code, with writable runtime state in the supplied index directory.

{"query_id":"example","results":[{"doc_id":"document-id","score":0.123}]}

Return at most ten distinct known IDs per query, sorted by finite descending scores, with ties following corpus order. Empty results are valid. Every query must appear exactly once; output row order is unrestricted.

Evaluation

Reward is mean binary nDCG@10 over all 778 questions, without baseline subtraction. The ideal ranking contains up to ten relevant documents.

A timed-out or failed batch, malformed or missing output, or a failed mandatory trajectory compliance audit yields zero overall; there is no partial batch credit.

The full contract is in the benchmark's task instructions, task documentation, and runtime configuration.
